lines.t: (Verse 1)
Thank you, Lord
I praise You
All Your ways are wonderful and right,
Gifts fall freely from above, into the humble hearts who love,
In all your ways, oh Lord, I find delight
(Verse 2)
Thank you, Lord
I praise You
All Your ways are wisdom and truth
You know the everlasting, that our flesh is so contrasting
The God who sees and knows a heart like Ruth
(Chorus)
Lord, I give thanks to You in every season and time,
I'll still believe in Your faithfulness even when I
Cannot recognize, narrow vision in my eyes,
I'll learn to trust your ways instead of mine
(Verse 3)
Thank You, Lord
I praise You
You know what I want and the needs that I do
Father you have always known, your love and goodness has always shown,
What is left but that I give myself to you
(Chorus)
Lord, I give thanks to you in every season and time
I'll still believe in your faithfulness even when I
Cannot recognize, narrow vision in my eyes,
I'll learn to trust your ways instead of mine
(Verse 4)
Thank you, Lord
I praise you
Your Love has always been enough
(Chorus)
Lord, I give thanks to you in every season and time
I'll still believe in your faithfulness even when I
Cannot recognize, narrow vision in my eyes,
I'll learn to trust your ways instead of mine
